public_rationale: The catch-up component is well supported. Artificial Analysis placed Gemini 3 Pro above GPT-5.1 across its overall index, and launch leaderboard results corroborate competitive capability. But squandered also attributes waste or responsibility to OpenAI. The reviewed evidence does not establish that causal component. Calling the whole claim supported would silently reduce squandered to a change in relative ranking. Missing causal proof is not counterevidence, so mixed is also inappropriate.
limitations: Public benchmarks sample capabilities and do not establish superiority on every task.
Google's disclosure is interested-party evidence, supplemented here by independent evaluation.
Potentially relevant reporting behind an inaccessible page was excluded.
The causal implication remains uncertain even though the capability results were public by the evaluation date.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI has basically squandered the technical lead it once had, and Google has caught up.

statement.excerpt: OpenAI has basically squandered the technical lead it once had; Google has caught up.

from_speaker: the technical lead it once had
our_interpretation: Technical catch-up means broad capability parity with OpenAI's leading models, not victory on every task or commercial parity.
Squandered implies that OpenAI wasted an existing advantage through its decisions or execution. Losing relative benchmark position alone does not establish that implication.
Basically allows approximate parity; it does not remove the implication of waste or responsibility.

The current capability comparison uses the latest public launch-period evidence on November 18–19, 2025. Earlier evidence can establish the historical premise but is context for that current comparison.
The full proposition is assessed together. Support for catch-up with insufficient evidence about responsibility produces unresolved, not mixed.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evaluations establish an earlier OpenAI advantage and Google's broad catch-up by publication, while credible records connect loss of that advantage to avoidable OpenAI decisions, wasted opportunities, or execution failures.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable broad evaluations show OpenAI retained a clear technical lead at publication, or credible causal evidence establishes that the alleged squandering did not occur. Missing causal evidence alone is not contradiction.
